title: Beasts rebuilt in 3D
changes: War-hounds, gildhounds, bone hounds, vultures, crown crows, rattlers, giant scorpions and gullet worms are now built as 3D models and drawn as pixel art: studded collars and bristling manes, ribcages you can see through, ragged wings, a coiled snake with its rattle up, a scorpion's arched sting and a worm's ringed maw of teeth.
Same size on screen and no cost to performance.
